title: Tags
intro: The only tags an ADR may carry, grouped into categories. Everyone can read them; administrators curate the categories and their tags (a tag belongs to exactly one category).
loadFailed: Could not load the tag categories

field.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add each tag. Lowercase letters, digits, spaces and . _ / + # : - are allowed; a tag belongs to only one category.

validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 500 characters
validation.tag: Tag "{{tag}}" must be 1–{{max}} characters: letters and digits, with spaces and . _ / + # : - inside

saveForbidden: Only administrators can edit tag categories
saveConflict: The category name or one of its tags is already in use
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveStale: Another administrator changed this category after you opened it. Your edit was not saved: close this dialog and open the category again to see the latest version.
saveGone: This category no longer exists — reload the page
deleteFailed: Could not delete the tag category
deleteStale: This category was changed after you opened it, so it was not deleted. Reload the page and check its tags before deleting it.
deleteBody: "{{name}}" and its tags will leave the registry. ADRs that carry those tags keep them, marked as retired, until the tags are edited.
